description:
Sign-in of the app's users: what is enabled, and the sender name of its emails.

    Provider keys are never returned. Connecting Yandex, VK ID or Sber ID needs
    a secret — that is done by the person in the dashboard or with
    `layero data auth provider set` in a terminal, not through the chat.
    Setting the sender needs a token with the admin scope.

action.description: `status` — sign-in methods, providers and the callback URL for the provider console; `sender` — set the sender name of sign-in emails.
action.title: Action

database.description: The database: name, slug or id. Without it — the organization's only database with the Data API enabled.
